verdict.rationale: Supabase docs describe self-hosting as a way to gain 'full control over your data' and meet 'compliance requirements' (supabase-docs-3/29/32), which implies a route to data residency, but the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of a managed-cloud region-selection feature (e.g., picking an AWS region at project creation) for regular hosted projects. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of region choice for the managed Supabase platform, and any data-residency/compliance certification details beyond generic self-host guidance.
